title.en: Breaking news: GHEOPARD and Ceontixx hit with a 7-day VAC cooldown
title.ro: Breaking news: GHEOPARD și Ceontixx, cooldown VAC de 7 zile
title.hu: Friss hír: GHEOPARD és Ceontixx 7 napos VAC cooldownt kapott

news.text:
Unexpected trouble has hit the Ciuc Navi main roster! Two of our players have received VAC cooldowns after queuing alongside someone they believed to be a legitimate player. Unfortunately, it later turned out that their teammate wasn't quite as innocent as everyone thought, leaving our players caught in the crossfire. To be clear, our players were not knowingly playing with a cheater, nor were they accused of hacking themselves. Nevertheless, the consequences have arrived, and the server is now missing two familiar faces for the next 7 days. We stand by our players and hope this situation gets resolved soon. Until then, consider this an unexpected team bootcamp... sponsored by Valve.

#JusticeForCiucNavi #ValvePlsFix

title.ro: stfandrei trece pe banca de rezerve

news.text: After careful consideration, Ciuc Navi has decided to make a change to the active roster, moving stfandrei to the bench. Following nearly a month of inactivity, we felt it was time to make a change and give the team a fresh start moving forward. However, this decision doesn't take away from everything he has contributed to the team. We would like to thank stfandrei for his time, effort, unforgettable moments and all the games we've shared together. His place in the Ciuc Navi story is secured, even if his mouse needs a little rest. We wish him all the best, and who knows... perhaps this isn't the last time we'll see him on the server!
